verdict.stance: Constructive / Clean Asset Quality South African Top-4 Bank (BB / Ba2 / Baa3 Pos opco)
verdict.summary: Fitch affirmed Nedbank at 'BB' Stable in Oct 2026 and Moody's holds opco Nedbank Ltd deposits at Baa3 Positive (Group Ba2 Stable). H1 2026 showed +7% loan/deposit growth, Stage 3 NPL improvement to 1.49% (from 1.81%), and 12.6% CET1 above target, though CLR ticked up to 95bp near top of 60-100bp guidance.

positives: Strong capital buffer: H126 CET1 12.6% (FY25 12.9%) above board's 11.0%-12.5% target range.
Improving Stage 3 NPL ratio to 1.49% in H126 (vs 1.81% H125) alongside +7% YoY deposit & loan growth.
Moody's opco deposit rating Baa3 Positive (Oct-26 Fitch BB Stable, AAA(zaf) national).
negatives: Credit loss ratio rose to 95bp in H126 (from 81bp H125), testing upper end of 60-100bp through-the-cycle range.
Lower international scale and ROE vs FirstRand/Standard Bank peers.
Ratings constrained by South African sovereign ceiling.

background.business_overview: One of South Africa's 'Big Four' universal banks (JSE: NED), strong in Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) and retail/wealth.
background.asset_perimeter: South Africa core banking (~ZAR 1.56tn assets) plus SADC subsidiaries and Ecobank associate stake.
background.ownership_governance: Widely held on JSE; regulated by SARB Prudential Authority; $2bn EMTN programme.

recent_drivers: Oct-26: Fitch affirmed Nedbank Long-Term IDR at 'BB' Stable (VR 'bb', AAA(zaf)); Moody's maintains Nedbank Ltd Baa3 Positive.
